text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc said Thursday it agreed to acquire Gaess Outdoor, a New York based outdoor advertising company with 25 displays, for $18 million.
Additional pending displays will be purchased for future payments totaling $1.5 million, the company said in a news release.
Universal also said it agreed to acquire 17 displays from New York Signs for $9 million with potential future payments for pending displays totaling $1.5 million..
In the Memphis, Tenn./Tunica, Miss. market, Universal said it completed purchase of 143 displays for $2.5 million.

In another development, Universal said it agreed to form two joint ventures in China involving outdoor advertising. Universal said it expects an initial investment of about $5 million in the two joint ventures.
